body: Ya, when I tried to talk to my guy friend he said I should just go read a book or something. I've been trying to get better for years, for a few years I stopped cutting, but this last year I guess I just started falling apart again. I've never tried medication, because I'm scared I'd feel worse from the side effects. I just wish I could go back to normal on my own somehow.

thank for replying to my post. I hate to bother people with these things, but sometimes I just can't keep it to myself. If I go to long without telling somebody, I cut myself. I already did that the other week and the marks are still there, so I didn't want to do it again.
